# Audio File

Place a royalty-free instrumental wedding music file here named `royalty-free-instrumental.mp3`

Recommended sources:
- Pixabay (pixabay.com) - search for "wedding instrumental"
- Uppbeat (uppbeat.io) - has free tracks
- Mixkit (mixkit.co) - free stock music

The audio should be soft, romantic, and appropriate for a wedding invitation.
